section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion reports a single study of adult women showing that body appreciation uniquely predicted better sexual function, greater sexual satisfaction, and lower sexual distress, beyond BMI and appearance dissatisfaction. Body appreciation did not vary with age but moderated the negative relationship between age and sexual satisfaction (buffering satisfaction among women with high body appreciation), while it did not moderate age-related sexual distress.

section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion summarizes a single study (Study X) examining how body appreciation and appearance dissatisfaction relate to sexual function, satisfaction, and distress in adult women across the lifespan; body appreciation predicted better sexual outcomes above BMI and appearance dissatisfaction. The authors report that body appreciation did not vary with age but moderated the negative relation between age and sexual satisfaction (especially among women with clinically significant sexual difficulties).
